title: Rust decompress-side finalize_checksum lacks computed-zero to 0xFFFF mapping; reconstructed UDP datagram can emit illegal wire 0x0000
description: P2, out-of-scope note from kimi edge-cases codereview pass of project-LICHEN-worker6-hahk. rust/lichen-schc/src/headers.rs:203-209 finalize lacks the computed-zero -> 0xFFFF mapping that C (lichen/subsys/lichen/schc/schc_checksum.c:62 finalize_checksum) and Python (python/src/lichen/schc/udp.py:77 or 0xFFFF) implement, and headers.rs:466 uses it for packet reconstruction on decompress. A UDP datagram whose true checksum computes to 0x0000 (legal; RFC 768/8200 require transmitting it as 0xFFFF) would be reconstructed by Rust emitting the illegal wire value 0x0000, where C and Python emit 0xFFFF - cross-impl divergence on the decompress/reconstruct path. Compress-side (ones_complement_sum codec.rs:602-613) is correct. Fix: apply the same mapping in headers.rs finalize (or route reconstruction through the compress-side checksum), pin with a shared vector whose UDP checksum computes to zero, rerun the parity gate.
